title: Ospreys returned to breed in southern England for first time since 1847

title: Male redback spiders somersault directly towards a female’s fangs during mating

Conversely, abdominal narrowing seems influenced by a combination of multiple genes and environmental conditions, challenging traditional views on the complexity of genetic traits.
